WHO WE ARE

A solutions-driven manufacturer
that listens, adapts, and delivers.

OSRM is India's leading manufacturer of advanced packaging for the cement and building materials industries — operating three fully integrated units in Rewa, Madhya Pradesh.

Founded on the legacy of MAA Polypack (established 2014) and incorporating OSRM Tech Pack in 2021, the group has grown into 300+ professionals across three plants — OSRM Tech Pack, Saawariya Polypack, and MAA Polypacks Industries — together supplying 180+ clients across 15+ countries.

Our founders personally visited customer plants across India — studying challenges on the shop floor and understanding real-world packaging problems. That hands-on approach shapes everything we manufacture today.

Equipped with European Starlinger machinery, Lohia Corp high-volume looms, Pelican flexographic printing, in-house recycling, and triple ISO certification, OSRM has become a trusted name in industrial packaging for the world's most demanding cement producers.

OUR JOURNEY

A decade of building scale.

From 5 million pillow sacks to 25 million block bottom bags per month — the OSRM group's growth, in milestones.

2015

Group operations begin with 5 million pillow-type cement bags/month.

2016

Production doubled to 10 million pillow-type cement bags/month.

2021

New plant goes live with 6.5 million pillow-type cement bags/month.

2021

OSRM Tech Pack launches with 20 million LPP & BOPP block bottom bags/month.

2023

Group capacity expands to 25M+ block bottom and 15M+ woven sacks per month.

SUSTAINABILITY

The future of packaging must be
powerful and responsible.

A closed-loop packaging cycle, designed in-house.

OSRM combines the know-how and technology for circular packaging under one roof. Our PP woven bags are a mono-material — 99% polypropylene even when coated — making them an ideal candidate for collection and recycling.

Our Polystar Repro reprocessing line transforms used bags into high-quality recycled granules, fed back into production of new LPP and BOPP bags that exceed industry quality standards. Up to 50% recyclate is achievable in tape production thanks to advanced melt filtration technology.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Common questions about OSRM Tech Pack.

What does OSRM Tech Pack manufacture?
OSRM Tech Pack manufactures industrial packaging for the cement and building materials industries — Ad*Star PP laminated block bottom valve bags, Ad*Star BOPP woven bags, pillow sacks, FIBC bulk bags, multifilament yarn, and filler and colour masterbatches. Combined capacity across the OSRM group is 25 million block bottom bags per month, 15 million PP woven sacks per month, and 200,000 FIBC bulk bags per month.
How many manufacturing units does OSRM operate?
The OSRM group operates three fully integrated manufacturing units in Rewa, Madhya Pradesh: Unit I (OSRM Tech Pack Private Limited), Unit II (Saawariya Polypack Private Limited), and Unit III (MAA Polypacks Industries (Ind) Private Limited). Together they employ 300+ people.
Where is OSRM Tech Pack located?
OSRM Tech Pack's works are at Plot No. 49A to 53A, 63 to 67, 63A to 67A, MPIDC Industrial Area, Udyog Vihar, Chorhata, Rewa, MP 486001, India. The registered office is at "Khattri House", Near Bhagwan Sheet Bhandar, Kothi Road, Rewa, MP 486001.
Who are OSRM Tech Pack's customers?
OSRM supplies 180+ clients across 15+ countries including Holcim, Aditya Birla Group, UltraTech Cement, Cemex, ACC, Ambuja Cement, Heidelberg Materials, Heidelberg Cement, Dalmia Bharat, Adani, Prism Johnson Limited, MP Birla Group, and Saint-Gobain.
Is OSRM Tech Pack ISO certified?
Yes. OSRM Tech Pack is certified to ISO 9001:2015 (Quality Management), ISO 14001 (Environmental Management), and ISO 45001:2018 (Occupational Health and Safety Management). The company also operates an in-house ERP system for complete batch traceability and a three-layer quality control process including third-party external inspection.
Are OSRM bags recyclable and sustainable?
Yes. OSRM PP woven bags are mono-material packaging consisting of 99% polypropylene even when coated, making them fully recyclable. OSRM operates an in-house Polystar Repro recycling line that processes used bags back into high-quality granules, allowing up to 50% recycled content in new tape production. OSRM is also EPR-compliant and has adopted solar energy across operations.
How can I request a quote from OSRM Tech Pack?
You can request a quote by emailing corp@osrmgroup.com. Please share your product requirement (bag type, capacity, GSM, print colours, quantity per month, delivery location) for a fast response from the OSRM sales team.
